title: Draw a paper boat voyage
summary: Tell the same small paper-boat story through hand-drawn-canvas-animation; compare staging, motion and artistic choices across models.
originNote: Original fictional paper-boat brief developed during a requested comparison of two public animation skills. The task was tried informally; this benchmark shape awaits owner acceptance.

setup.instructions: Verify fixtures/skill.tar.gz against fixtures/skill-lock.json, extract it into the workspace and read skill/SKILL.md. Work from that immutable source snapshot. Provide Node, Python, FFmpeg and a pinned browser/render environment identically to every model before cooking. Dependency setup is allowed; film inputs are local. This draft needs owner acceptance and a render-environment smoke before becoming Ready.

turns.content: Read fixtures/brief.md and the supplied skill. Create A Little Voyage through that workflow and deliver the specified film, live drawing player, source and contact sheet. Make routine artistic choices yourself and iterate from rendered evidence.

checks.description: Check the shared player, nonempty deliverables, PNG signature, H.264/AAC, 1080 by 1920, 24fps, 576 frames and 24-second duration.

Watch with sound; inspect story clarity, expressive poses, physical contacts, timing, lettering, continuity and artistic character. Review source for original code-authored visuals and synthesized audio.
